name: iSingWorship
shortDescription: A UK-developed worship backing-track and lyric-projection app for church services, offering flexible song arrangements, chords, playlists and presentation output across desktop and mobile devices.
company: The Worship Zone Ltd, trading as iSingWorship (company number 09650251)
suitableContexts: Churches or small groups using backing tracks with lyric projection
Worship teams that need to adapt song sections, keys, tempos or arrangements live
Services where one operator needs music, lyrics and an external display in a single app

pricing.summary: The supplier publishes individual-song purchases at £3.99 each. It also publishes USD subscriptions: iSingWorship Plus at $16.99/month or $199.99/year, Essential at $12.99/month or $155.88/year, and Upgrade at $5.99/month or $69.99/year. Ask for the payable currency, VAT, licence scope and current payment route before purchase.

editorial.assessment: iSingWorship is a focused worship-leading and projection tool, not a general slide deck or church-management platform. It is especially relevant where a church needs flexible backing tracks and lyrics without a full live band, or wants to alter arrangement, key or tempo during worship. The active company name has changed, and subscription prices are displayed in USD despite the UK organisation, so ask for the payable price, music licence scope and device limits before adopting it.
bestFor: Small churches and groups using backing tracks with projected lyrics
Worship teams that want flexible song arrangement, key and tempo control
Teams wanting an app that runs across common desktop and mobile devices
strengths: Active UK not-for-profit company with a documented company-number continuity
Individual-song and subscription routes, with broad device support
limitations: Not a general-purpose presentation, livestreaming or church-administration system
Subscription prices are displayed in USD and purchase/licensing terms need a live checkout check
Current detailed hosting, privacy and account-deletion information was not established in this review
